items.description: File category the generator must read.

referencedTags.description: Tags from other configurations whose classes may be referenced in code generated by this module's generators.

additionalProperties.description: Name of the configuration from which to retrieve the tag.

variables.description: Global configuration variables that can be used in all configuration properties.

tagVariables.description: Per-tag configuration variables that can be used in configuration properties that support them.

ignoreDefaultValues.description:
Disables generation of default property values in classes and endpoints generated with this configuration.

- Default: `false`.

translateReferences.description:
Whether reference list labels must be translated in this configuration.

- Default: the value set in the global `i18n` section.

translateProperties.description:
Whether property labels must be translated in this configuration.

- Default: the value set in the global `i18n` section.

disable.description: Generators to disable for this configuration.

oneOf.description:
Uses lowercase table and column names.

- Default: `true`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

- Default: `true`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

endpointsFilePath.description:
Output path for the endpoint listing file, relative to the generation directory. Output granularity is inferred from the variables: one file per model file when `{fileName}` is present, one per module when `{module}` is present, otherwise one global file.

- Default: `endpoints.md`.
- Templating: `{module}`, `{fileName}`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

classesFilePath.description:
Output path for the class dictionary file, relative to the generation directory. Output granularity is inferred from the variables: one file per model file when `{fileName}` is present, one per module when `{module}` is present, otherwise one global file.

- Default: `classes.md`.
- Templating: `{module}`, `{fileName}`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

mermaidFilePath.description:
Output path for Mermaid diagram files, relative to the generation directory. Output granularity is inferred from the variables: one diagram per model file when `{fileName}` is present, one per module when `{module}` is present, otherwise one global diagram.

- Default: `{module}.md`.
- Templating: `{module}`, `{fileName}`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

schemas.description: Mapping between database schemas and tags of classes persisted in them.

additionalProperties.description: Tags whose persisted classes belong to the schema

items.description: Tag whose persisted classes belong to the schema

authorizationAnnotations.description: Annotation names (for example, `RoleRequired`, `HasRole`) whose arguments must be aggregated to populate the `Authorization` column in the endpoint list. If empty or omitted, the `Authorization` column is not generated.

items.description: Name of an annotation whose arguments will be concatenated in the `Authorization` column.
